name: Living Vengeance

parts.label: Innate
parts.text: Innate: When Varus kills an enemy, he gains 10 / 15 / 20 (based on level)% bonus attack speed as well as bonus attack damage and ability power equal to 11% of his total bonus attack speed for 5 / 7 / 9 / 11 (based on level) seconds, refreshing on subsequent unit kills.

Innate: When Varus kills an enemy, he gains 10 / 15 / 20 (based on level)% bonus attack speed as well as bonus attack damage and ability power equal to 11% of his total bonus attack speed for 5 / 7 / 9 / 11 (based on level) seconds, refreshing on subsequent unit kills.

parts.text: Varus also gains Living Vengeance's bonuses upon scoring a champion takedown, which empowers it for the same duration to grant him 30% bonus attack speed as well as bonus attack damage and ability power equal to 33% of his total bonus attack speed, and an increased attack speed cap of 3.33. Living Vengeance's empowerment may only be refreshed by subsequent champion takedowns.

notes:
Varus cannot gain the standard bonuses while Living Vengeance is empowered. If the buff was active at the time of the empowerment (from scoring a champion takedown), the duration is refreshed while overriding the standard bonuses with the empowered ones.
  - If Varus kills an enemy unit (non-champion) during the empowerment, he is special cased to gain the buff again after the empowerment expires with the standard bonuses. The re-granted buff lasts for 5 / 7 / 9 / 11 (based on level) seconds minus the remaining duration of the empowered version at the time of the last non-champion unit he killed.

values.label: Missile plus area check total range
Tether escape radius after being registered

parts.label: Active
parts.text: Active: Varus unleashes a tendril of corruption in the target direction that infects the first enemy champion hit, dealing magic damage and rooting them for 2 seconds, during which they are revealed. Over the first 1.75 seconds of the root, they are also inflicted with maximum stacks of Blight.

mechanics.evidence: Active: Varus unleashes a tendril of corruption in the target direction that infects the first enemy champion hit, dealing magic damage and rooting them for 2 seconds, during which they are revealed.
Active: Varus unleashes a tendril of corruption in the target direction that infects the first enemy champion hit, dealing magic damage and rooting them for 2 seconds, during which they are revealed.

tips.tip: Estimated, see notes for specific stack application timings

parts.text: Upon impact, the tendril roots into the ground from where the target was hit, seeking out nearby enemy champions that are in the immediate area. If a target does not leave the area within 2 seconds, they subsequently become infected as well, taking the same damage and effects. A new tendril is then spread out from the infected target that is closest to a nearby uninfected enemy champion. The infection can spread repeatedly until there are no new targets.
The target does not have to be visible to be caught by the tendril.

mechanics.evidence: The target does not have to be visible to be caught by the tendril.

notes:
The first Blight stack is applied after ~0.65 seconds into the root duration, while the remaining ones are applied in 0.55-second intervals thereafter.
  - Second and third stacks are applied after ~1.2 seconds and ~1.75 seconds into the root duration, respectively.
  - If the root's duration is reduced by the target's tenacity, the stacks are applied depending upon if their time application interval is met.
    - For example, if the root lasts for 1 second, only the first stack is applied since the second and third stacks did not meet their time intervals.
    - If the root lasts for less than the first stack application time (<0.65 seconds), the first stack will instead be applied at the end of the root duration.
  - If the target cleanses the root immediately after it is applied, no stacks will be applied.
    - In cases where the cleanse is activated later into the root duration, stack application is dependent upon their time application interval being met. If removal occurs before an interval after one having been passed, remaining stacks are not applied.

If the root is not applied, such as by the target negating its application with crowd control immunity or a spell shield, the target will not be inflicted with Blight stacks and the tendril will not root into the ground at their location (thus preventing it from seeking). This applies to both the primary target and secondary targets that were caught by the tendril.
The tendril seeks and registers valid targets every 0.264.
Enemy champions can be targeted again by the corruption's tether if they were not infected the previous time, even if they were targeted and exited its range.
The tendril cannot seek enemy champions that are untargetable, and will also stop seeking a target if it becomes untargetable (fails to apply its effects even if they remain in the area).
Varus will turn to face the target direction at the start of the cast.
This ability will cast from wherever the caster is at the end of the cast time.

Chain of Corruption can generate Blight stacks for Varus to detonate with any ability, even if Blighted Quiver has not been learned. The base detonation damage per Blight stack scales with Blighted Quiver's rank, which has a value at rank 0 of 2.5% of the target's maximum health per stack detonated.

name: Blighted Quiver

values.label: Starts after the effect is used with Piercing Arrow

parts.label: Passive
parts.text: Passive: Varus basic attacks on-hit deal bonus magic damage and apply a stack of Blight for 6 seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications and stacking up to 3 times. Varus' abilities detonate all Blight stacks on affected enemies hit.

mechanics.evidence: Passive: Varus basic attacks on-hit deal bonus magic damage and apply a stack of Blight for 6 seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications and stacking up to 3 times.

parts.label: Blight
parts.text:
Blight: For each stack consumed, the target is dealt bonus magic damage. If the stacks were consumed with Piercing Arrow, this damage is increased by 0% – 50% (based on Piercing Arrow's charge time). This damage is capped at 120 per stack against monsters, for a total cap of 360 at maximum stacks.

Additionally, each stack consumed against a champion or epic monster reduces the remaining cooldowns of Varus' basic abilities by 13% of each of their total cooldowns, up to a 39% cooldown reduction per target. parts.text: Active: Varus next Piercing Arrow within 5.5 seconds is empowered to deal additional bonus magic damage, increased by 0% – 50% (based on Piercing Arrow's charge time). This damage is capped at 360 against monsters.

If Varus does not cast Piercing Arrow, Blighted Quiver can be recast after 1 second within the duration, and does so automatically afterwards or when he dies. Blighted Quiver can be cast during the first 0.85 seconds of Piercing Arrow charge, and will be placed on full cooldown after the charge ends even if Piercing Arrow is not recast.

parts.label: Recast
parts.text: Recast: Varus ends Blighted Quiver and places it on a 1-second cooldown.
Blighted Quiver's active and recast can both be used while affected by cast-inhibiting crowd control.

notes: The monster damage cap is also increased by 0% – 50% (based on Piercing Arrow's charge time) if the stacks were consumed with Piercing Arrow.
Spell shield will not block the on-hit damage but will block the consumption damage if the target is hit by his abilities.

Blighted Quiver will not apply stacks nor deal on-hit damage if blocked by blind, block or dodge effects.
  - The consumption damage will not be blocked.
Blighted Quiver's active damage is dealt after the damage of Piercing Arrow.
Blighted Quiver does not count as an ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as Spellblade and triggering Force Pulse passive.
The attacks do not affect structures nor wards.
